d:
Gold Rush takes a difficult turn as Todd Hoffman is left with a skeleton crew after his miners quit. With fewer hands to keep the operation running, Todd struggles to stay in the game. Meanwhile, Parker Schnabel damages his truck while moving his washplant, and Tony Beets discovers that his dredge is losing gold through its sluices. Can the miners recover before things get worse?
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 12, on Discovery Channel India.
